The human-readable reference page for this API meets the same WCAG 2.2 AA gate (axe 0 violations at 320/1280; code samples are text, not images)
mobile_behavior: Not a visual surface
audit_consequences: Each submitted request appends an audit event (principal, role, sponsor, channel, request reference, contract and form version, client time and server time); drafts are not audit events

ai_assistance.may_recommend: Explain fields, statuses and blocking reasons from assistance contracts
ai_assistance.never_executes: Execute any command above the agent's registered ceiling; A3+ commands are never available to agents (AIN-003)
ai_assistance.contract: caller-scoped assistance contracts per RR-REQ-X-051-r1; output labelled 'AI-generated, not a decision' with sources and as-of (UNB-UI-G-011)

acceptance_criteria.given: an agent submits the same proposal twice with one idempotency key
acceptance_criteria.then: one proposal exists

acceptance_criteria.given: an accepted proposal
acceptance_criteria.then: it reads 'Accepted into draft', never 'Approved' or 'Executed' (AIN-014)

name: Agent proposal review inbox
purpose: Humans accept, edit or reject agent proposals.
permissions: Authority per command.. A3+ actions only for the owning sponsor's decision team (UNB-SMP-ORG-003); preparer is never the decider
information_hierarchy: Proposal diff with evidence and agent identity/version
Accept into draft / Edit / Reject with reason
loading_state: Skeleton matching the final layout so nothing shifts when data arrives (UNB-UI-DS-014); aria-busy on the updating region; headline figures never render as 0 or '$0.00' while loading; freshness strip shows 'Loading data as of ...' then the watermark time; if loading exceeds the journey's response objective (UNB-XIN-SAS-008), 'Still loading' with Cancel and Retry
error_states: Service unavailable: inline fault with a copyable fault reference and 'Try again'; entered values kept (UNB-UI-G-012)
Signed-out or session expired: sign-in again returns the user to the same view; unsent drafts kept
Permission changed since the page loaded: the action is re-checked on submit and refused with 'You no longer have permission to do this' and the role that can act
Record changed by someone else: 'This record changed since you opened it' with a reload that shows what changed (optimistic concurrency)
Submission outcome unknown: 'We could not confirm this was recorded' with 'Check status' using the same request reference; no automatic resubmission (UNB-UI-G-006)
accessibility: axe-core (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) reports 0 violations at 320 and 1280 CSS px, in every state and every opened dialog/flyout (UNB-UI-A-001)
All functionality operable by keyboard alone; focus order equals visual order; focus indicator >=3:1 and never fully obscured by sticky bars (WCAG 2.4.7, 2.4.11; UNB-UI-A-002)
Every status rendered as text in a status chip, never colour alone (UNB-UI-G-001, WCAG 1.4.1)
Pointer targets >=24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8); no page-level horizontal scroll at 320 CSS px or 400% zoom (WCAG 1.4.10)
Exactly one h1 naming the page; landmarks header/nav/main/footer present (UNB-UI-A-003)

On failed submit focus moves to a validation summary whose links focus each invalid field; fields carry aria-invalid and aria-describedby to their message; entered values are kept (UNB-UI-G-012, WCAG 3.3.1/3.3.3)
No information already provided in the same process is requested again (WCAG 3.3.7) and authentication has no cognitive-function test without an alternative (WCAG 3.3.8; UNB-UI-A-005)
Confirmation dialog: focus moves to dialog heading on open, is contained while open, Escape cancels, focus returns to the invoking control on close (UNB-UI-DS-015)
Unavailable actions remain visible, are disabled with the reason as visible text at >=4.5:1 contrast and linked by aria-describedby (FORMA-GAP-11)
Asynchronous command results are announced once via a polite live region; an outcome-unknown result is announced as 'Outcome not yet confirmed', never as success (UNB-UI-G-006)
mobile_behavior: Phone-review-and-approve: review and the decision itself are possible on a phone (evidence, consequences and the confirm dialog fit 320 px); evidence editing and bulk preparation are desktop-first; container-driven reflow inside panes (UNB-UI-R-002).
audit_consequences: Each staff action appends an audit event with principal, employing organization, authority class, evidence snapshot hash, policy version and reason text; segregation-of-duties check result is recorded

ai_assistance.may_recommend: Explain fields, statuses and blocking reasons from assistance contracts
ai_assistance.never_executes: Accept; and generally: Record or submit any decision, approval, release, disposition, posting, payment or hold change; change queue rank; close a case it raised (RR-UNB-AI-STD-003-r1)
ai_assistance.contract: caller-scoped assistance contracts per RR-REQ-X-051-r1; output labelled 'AI-generated, not a decision' with sources and as-of (UNB-UI-G-011)

reusable_components: gap FORMA-GAP-16 [MISSING: AI output provenance label / action-free handoff]

acceptance_criteria.given: a proposal whose source facts changed after submission
acceptance_criteria.then: acceptance is blocked with 'Facts changed; ask for a new proposal' (AIN-022)

acceptance_criteria.given: a proposal raised by an agent about its own action
acceptance_criteria.then: the agent cannot close or resolve it (RR-UNB-AI-STD-003-r1)

acceptance_criteria.given: the screen in each of its documented states at 320x800 and 1280x800
acceptance_criteria.when: an axe-core scan with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa runs
acceptance_criteria.then: it reports 0 violations and the page has no horizontal scroll (document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)
